build_image_chat_dataset: build the image_chat dataset by downloading image_chat.tgz and setting up the data directory
run_build_function: run the build function to download and prepare the image_chat task data with version tracking
download_image_chat_resources: download the image_chat resources from parl.ai into the specified datapath directory
download_yfcc_images: download YFCC images for the image_chat task when load_images option is enabled
review_build_function: review the build function to understand how image_chat data is downloaded and versioned
